overview: Rosencrantz and Guildensterm, minor characters from the play 'Hamlet', find themselves on the road to Elsinore Castle at the behest of the King of Denmark. The duo encounter a band of players before arriving to find that they are needed to try to discern what troubles the prince Hamlet. Meanwhile, they ponder the meaning of their existence.
tagline: A man talking sense to himself is no madder than a man talking nonsense not to himself.
title: Rosencrantz & Guildenstern Are Dead
